drafted_from: tool:recognise-a-repeat row in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/tool-rows.json, its code in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ and tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs; the answers were produced by running the tool against a stand-in model server
start_here: Say to your AI: "File this flagged note under claims-done and tell me if I have seen it before: 'the sourdough order is ready, trust me, nothing was counted', from Monday's session." It files the text and reports how many times it came up.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it keeps the flagged shapes in a memory file on this computer that you name.
instructions: 1. Choose a memory file (/work/judge/shapes.json) and your two numbers: keep_characters (how much of a text to keep) and plainly_the_same_at (0 to 1, the word overlap at which two texts are the same).

2. Write /work/judge/request.json: {"memory_file", "rubric_id", "excerpt", "session", "keep_characters", "plainly_the_same_at"}. Add providers (and pass_when_share_correct, same_at_least) to let a model decide near matches.
3. Say "Note this repeat". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs note-repeat < /work/judge/request.json.
4. Read result: shape (its id), times, sessions, first_seen and repeat (true when it was seen before).

worked_examples.title: The same note on Monday and Tuesday counts as a repeat of one shape
worked_examples.ask: Have I seen this flagged note before?
worked_examples.given: From tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs (test "note-repeat: the same text again is counted as a repeat..."), run for real with memory_file /work/judge/shapes.json, rubric_id "claims-done", excerpt "the sourdough order is ready, trust me, nothing was counted", keep_characters 600, plainly_the_same_at 0.8, session "monday", then again with session "tuesday", then with excerpt "oven temperature never written down". Command: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs note-repeat < /work/judge/request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: First: {"result": {"shape": "claims-done-1", "times": 1, "sessions": 1, "first_seen": "2026-11-14T01:28:09.900Z", "repeat": false}}. Second (Tuesday): {"result": {"shape": "claims-done-1", "times": 2, "sessions": 2, "first_seen": "2026-11-14T01:28:09.900Z", "repeat": true}}. Third (different text, no session): {"result": {"shape": "claims-done-2", "times": 1, "sessions": 0, "repeat": false}}.
